items.name: conversation-ui
items.title: Conversation UI provider
items.description: Labels, slots, locale, a renderer for custom message types, and the rich text pair (composer features and JSX converters) for every conversation component below it.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>

items.name: conversation-composer
items.title: Conversation composer
items.description: The Lexical composer skinned with shadcn tokens: toolbar, / and @ menus, links, send and edit.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>

items.name: conversation-message
items.title: Conversation message
items.description: One message: avatar, name, time, body, thread summary, a menu with reply, edit and delete, and inline editing.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>

items.name: conversation-feed
items.title: Conversation feed
items.description: The scrolling feed: day separators, grouping, the New messages divider, older pages and Jump to latest.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>

items.name: conversation-channel-tabs
items.title: Conversation channel tabs
items.description: One tab per readable channel, with unread counts.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>

items.name: conversation-thread
items.title: Conversation thread
items.description: A root message, its replies and a reply composer.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>

items.name: conversation-panel
items.title: Conversation panel
items.description: A whole conversation: channel tabs, feed, composer, and threads opening in place with a back button.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>

items.name: conversation-reactions
items.title: Conversation reactions
items.description: Reaction pills with an add button, the quick reactions row for the message menu, and reactionSlots for ConversationUIProvider.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>

items.name: conversation-attachments
items.title: Conversation attachments
items.description: The attach button, picked files inside the composer (drop and paste too), a message's files with an image and PDF viewer, and attachmentSlots for ConversationUIProvider.
items.author: 10x Media GmbH <https://github.com/10x-media>
